cases.input: Attendance is complete but assessment fails objective O1.
cases.expect: Normatively, a not-achieved Learning Result may be recorded without award or credential.

cases.input: One course serves objective versions O1 and O2.
cases.expect: Normatively, two distinct Learning Results share one Enrollment and Program Version.

cases.input: A learner retakes the assessment and achieves the objective.
cases.expect: Normatively, a successor result is appended and the failed result remains resolvable.

cases.input: Attendance alone is used as achieved outcome.
A qualification award replaces the Learning Result.
cases.expect: Normatively, the identity collapse is non-conformant.

cases.input: A Learning Result is exposed as a credential.
cases.expect: Normatively, the identity collapse is non-conformant.

cases.input: A result cites only an objective label.
cases.expect: Normatively, the result is non-conformant without objective-version identity.

cases.input: An indeterminate result is collapsed to not-achieved.
A pool entry omits validity or readiness target pin.
A state changes without actor or recorded time.
A successor omits its predecessor reference.
A transfer rewrites the predecessor Program Version pin.
A voided result loses actor, reason or tombstone.
Two valid results tie on ordering.
cases.expect: Normatively, the effective outcome is contested.
